sloka: न तस्य मूत्युरन्यो ऽस्ति कश्चिद्धि पुरुषर्षभ ।दर्शनं यो ऽभिगच्छेत स वध्यो लवणेन हि ।। ७.६४.९ ॥
transliteration: na tasya mūtyuranyo 'sti kaściddhi puruṣarṣabha ।darśanaṁ yo 'bhigaccheta sa vadhyo lavaṇena hi ।। 7.64.9 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, there is no other way to kill him, for anyone who approaches his sight is indeed slain by Lavana.
